sections.title: In brief
sections.text: Knight examines ambiguities in representing, constructing and classifying infinite patterns, focusing on friezes.

sections.title: Question or aim
sections.text: What changes when patterns are understood through the rules that construct them?

sections.title: Approach described
sections.text: The abstract excerpt describes a generative reading of frieze patterns.
